name: Anger Not Easily Appeased: only the Magic Crystal pacifies a Furious Gilded Treant for credit (COA-9749)
contract: Issue #9749: quest 175096 asks to pacify eight Furious Gilded Treants (164301) with the Magic Crystal of the Namarien Sanctuary 559904. Its spell Golden Tranquility 365042 on a treant weakened to 50% health or less makes the treant's SmartAI give the pacified credit and despawn it. Killing a treant gives no credit. The case kills one summoned treant and expects the objective to stay at 0, then weakens a second treant and uses the crystal on it and expects exactly one credit.

steps.label: SETUP: accepting the quest provides the Magic Crystal
SETUP: the first treant is slain
DISCRIMINATING: the kill alone pacifies nothing
SETUP: the second treant is weakened below half health
Use the Magic Crystal on the weakened treant
